page_title: NAP 2-0 VER | Napoli v Verona 12/01/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+3' Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) strikes from the edge of the box, but hits it really poorly and sends the ball way over the bar.
90+1' Fouls committed – 6:5.
90' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
90' That will be all from David Neres who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Alessio Zerbin (Napoli).

89' What a wasted opportunity by Dailon Rocha Livramento (Verona)! He creates some space for himself inside the penalty box and unleashes a decent strike towards the bottom left corner, but Alex Meret makes an astonishing save to thwart him.
88' Verona players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
86' Cyril Ngonge (Napoli) beats an opponent and drives towards the edge of the penalty area. He steadies himself and hits a tremendous shot that flashes a whisker past the left post.
85' Dangerous play by Frank Anguissa (Napoli). Luca Zufferli blows his whistle for a foul.
84' Paolo Zanetti has decided to make a change. Daniel Mosquera (Verona) replaces Reda Belahyane.
83' Substitution. Leonardo Spinazzola did his best and is replaced by Pasquale Mazzocchi (Napoli).
82' Grigoris Kastanos (Verona) releases a decent shot towards the middle of the goal from the edge of the box, but it's comfortably gathered by Alex Meret.
80' Dailon Rocha Livramento (Verona) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.
77' Antonio Conte has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) replacing Scott McTominay.
77' It is time for a substitution. Giovanni Simeone (Napoli) is on for Romelu Lukaku.
77' The game has come to an end for Matteo Politano. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Cyril Ngonge (Napoli).
77' Substitution. Davide Faraoni will be replaced by Flavius Daniliuc (Verona).
76' Paolo Zanetti decides to make a substitution. Casper Tengstedt will be replaced by Grigoris Kastanos (Verona).
76' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
74' Ondrej Duda (Verona) shoots from distance but it's wayward and goes high over the bar.
71' Leonardo Spinazzola (Napoli) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
69' Paolo Zanetti prepares a substitution. Darko Lazovic is replaced by Domagoj Bradaric (Verona).
69' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Amin Sarr walks off the pitch to be replaced by Dailon Rocha Livramento (Verona).
67' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 12:3.
64' Davide Faraoni (Verona) is penalised for holding. Luca Zufferli signals a set piece.
61' 2 - 0 Frank Anguissa (Napoli) breaks through the defence and scores a brilliant goal from outside the penalty area after firing the ball inside the right post!
60' Davide Faraoni (Verona) is caught offside!
59' Leonardo Spinazzola (Napoli) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Lorenzo Montipo, who smothers the ball.
57' David Neres (Napoli) sends a cross into the box, but Lorenzo Montipo comes off his line to gather the ball.
57' The corner by Leonardo Spinazzola (Napoli) lacks accuracy as it's hit with too much power.
56' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
55' Ondrej Duda (Verona) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
55' David Neres (Napoli) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
54' Leonardo Spinazzola (Napoli) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
53' Some great controlled play and passing from Napoli. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
50' Amir Rrahmani (Napoli) finds space in the box and tries a looping header at goal from the corner, but the ball goes just over the bar. Unlucky!
50' The referee awards a corner and Leonardo Spinazzola (Napoli) goes over to take it.

50' A nice cross arrived in the box from the corner kick and found the head of Amir Rrahmani (Napoli). He steered the ball towards the right post, but one of the defenders is there to cover the goalkeeper and keep it out.
50' Leonardo Spinazzola (Napoli) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
49' Scott McTominay (Napoli) aims a low effort to the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper makes a comfortable save.
48' Leonardo Spinazzola (Napoli) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
47' Half-chance! David Neres (Napoli) plays a pass into the box, but Lorenzo Montipo reacts well to snuff out the attack.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+1' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45' Scott McTominay (Napoli) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
44' Luca Zufferli blows his whistle after Davide Faraoni (Verona) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
43' Referee Luca Zufferli sees the trip by Stanislav Lobotka (Napoli) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
41' Matteo Politano (Napoli) takes the corner, but he overhits it and none of his teammates are able to reach the ball.
41' David Neres (Napoli) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
40' Ondrej Duda (Verona) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
37' Casper Tengstedt (Verona) evades several challenges inside the box and fires a shot in on goal, but that's a great block by the defender to stop an almost certain goal.
36' A pass into the penalty area from Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) is intercepted by the defence.
34' Matteo Politano (Napoli) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it.

31' Lorenzo Montipo doesn't have to worry about this one. David Neres plays a pass into the feet of Scott McTominay (Napoli), who is unable to find the target as his effort from inside the box goes high over the bar.
30' Frank Anguissa (Napoli) produces an effort from the edge of the box, but doesn't hit the ball properly and sends it yards over the bar.
30' Reda Belahyane (Verona) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
28' Napoli are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
25' Leonardo Spinazzola (Napoli) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
22' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
20' Pawel Dawidowicz (Verona) was too forceful with his tackle and Luca Zufferli interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
20' Leonardo Spinazzola (Napoli) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
19' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from David Neres (Napoli). Napoli have a corner.
18' David Neres (Napoli) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Lorenzo Montipo intercepts the ball.
17' Napoli are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
14' Casper Tengstedt (Verona) jumps for a cross and produces a fine header from near the penalty spot, but it goes a whisker over the bar! What a huge opportunity!
13' Leonardo Spinazzola (Napoli) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
13' Scott McTominay (Napoli) connects with a precise cross inside the goalmouth and shoots. One of the defending players reacts in time and clears the ball to safety.
12' What a chance that is! Romelu Lukaku (Napoli) finds himself unmarked in a promising position after receiving a cross on the edge of the box and his attempt sails a whisker wide of the left post.
12' Napoli produce a short pass from the free kick.

10' Giangiacomo Magnani (Verona) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Luca Zufferli blows his whistle for an infringement. Napoli earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
8' Leonardo Spinazzola (Napoli) swings in a cross from the corner, but Lorenzo Montipo reads it well and gathers the ball.
6' Frank Anguissa (Napoli) receives a well-played pass inside the penalty area and shoots. He sends the ball into orbit.
5' 1 - 0 What an unlucky own goal by Lorenzo Montipo (Verona)!
5' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) takes a shot from outside the box and hits the left post!
4' The ball is cleared after David Neres (Napoli) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
4' Some patient build-up play from Napoli as they look to unlock the defence.
